description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'ProductImageSizeUtils' providing static methods for image resizing operations. The methods include resizing without maintaining aspect ratio, resizing with hints and quality options, and resizing with aspect ratio preservation. The class is designed to assist in image manipulation tasks within the project.

classes.name: ProductImageSizeUtils
classes.description: Utility class for image resize functions, containing static methods for various image resizing techniques.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Performs a simple resize of an image without maintaining aspect ratio.

methods.name: resizeWithHint
methods.description: Resizes an image with specified rendering hints and an option for higher quality or faster processing.

methods.name: resizeWithRatio
methods.description: Resizes an image while maintaining the aspect ratio, based on target width and height parameters.
